title: Gradient Descent on Logistic Regression: Do Large Step-Sizes Work with Data on the Sphere?
abstract: arXiv:2507.11228v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Gradient descent on logistic regression has many fascinating properties not fully captured by classical analyses. For linearly separable data, the iterates converge in direction to the maximum-margin separator regardless of how large the step size is. For non-separable data, however, cycles may occur even for step sizes below the local stability threshold of $2/\lambda^*$, where $\lambda^*$ is the largest eigenvalue of the Hessian at the solution. We ask whether requiring all examples to have equal norm is a sufficient condition for global convergence below this threshold. We prove that this is indeed true in one dimension. In higher dimensions, even equal-norm datasets can produce cycles, although global convergence holds for the population loss when the examples are uniformly distributed on the sphere. translated_title: 逻辑回归上的梯度下降：大步长对球面数据有效吗？
translated_abstract: 逻辑回归上的梯度下降具有许多经典分析未能完全刻画的迷人特性。对于线性可分数据，无论步长多大，迭代点在方向上都会收敛到最大间隔分离器。然而，对于线性不可分数据，即使步长低于局部稳定性阈值 $2/\lambda^*$（其中 $\lambda^*$ 是解处 Hessian 矩阵的最大特征值），也可能出现循环。我们探究要求所有样本具有相等范数是否是低于该阈值时保证全局收敛的充分条件。我们证明这一结论在一维情况下确实成立。在更高维度中，即使是等范数数据集也可能产生循环，尽管当样本均匀分布在球面上时，总体损失（population loss）的全局收敛仍然成立。最后，在一维情况下，我们将等范数假设放宽为一个环形（annulus）条件，该条件可保证低于稳定性阈值时的全局收敛。
tldr: 本文研究逻辑回归中梯度下降在低于稳定性阈值 $2/\lambda^*$ 的大步长下的收敛性，证明等范数数据在一维时可保证全局收敛，等范数数据在高维可能产生循环但球面均匀分布的总体损失可全局收敛，并将一维结论推广到更弱的环形条件。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that for gradient descent on logistic regression, equal-norm data guarantees global convergence below the stability threshold 2/λ* in one dimension, while cycles can occur in higher dimensions even with equal norms—though global convergence holds for the population loss on the sphere—and the 1D result extends to a relaxed annulus condition.
